content.text: Fixed. `to_cents` in `ledger/currency.py` used `int(amount * 100)`, which truncates. Because of float error, `19.99 * 100` comes out as 1998.99…, so the result was 1998 instead of 1999. I changed it to `round(amount * 100)`. All 5 tests in `tests/` now pass, including the four in `tests/test_totals.py`.
